open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval lifecycle
open_points.text: "It is requested when a send of its element has no authority, and only when no approval of that element is `requested` already, so an element has at most one `requested` approval at a time"
open_points.question: What exact identity defines "its element" for approval uniqueness and reuse?

open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt.authority reference to flow activation
open_points.text: "the authority is named by its identity: an approval or a grant by its minted id, a flow activation by its position in the store's order (M18)"
open_points.question: What concrete field(s) identify a FlowActivation record when EffectAttempt stores authority, since M18 defines no explicit activation id field?
options: Use a store sequence/ordinal as part of M18

open_points.subject: K-15 / M28 token-change lifecycle
open_points.text: "the token says whether the agent may author"; "the kernel reads the token list again whenever it has changed"; M28 includes both `owner_token` and `agent_tokens`
open_points.question: When installation auth config changes, is live reload limited to agent tokens or does owner_token also take effect without restart?
options: Reload both owner_token and agent_tokens live
Reload only agent_tokens live; owner_token changes require restart
No live reload; all token changes require restart
open_points.default_guess: Reload only agent_tokens live; owner_token changes require restart

open_points.subject: Primary action vs K-16 binding preconditions
open_points.text: Primary actions: "propose an operation binding ... failure: manifest mismatch refused"; K-16 addendum: "a service is not invocable, and no binding for it can be proposed or accepted" when no instance is selected
open_points.question: For propose/accept binding on a service with no selected instance, is this a distinct refusal condition or treated as "manifest mismatch"?
options: Distinct refusal condition (service has no selected instance)
